props.name: layout
props.description: `block` is a rounded panel with a heading; `strip` is the thin centred bar across the very top of a site.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the message. Usually omitted in a strip, where the message is one sentence.

props.name: children
props.description: The message body — in a strip, the one sentence.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the message leads. Rendered as a link after it.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the banner is dismissed. Its presence, or `storageKey`, adds the dismiss button.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Remember the dismissal in this browser under this key. Change the key for the next announcement.
